topics.title: Strange Song Recording & Listener Calls
topics.summary: A man shares a bizarre recording of an unknown song with explicit lyrics and racial slurs, attempting to recreate it while referencing Puff Daddy. He discusses callers wanting concert tickets and offering opinions on the music's content, including a listener recounting receiving a pair of red panties from a friend detailing their smell.

topics.title: Anthrax Threat and Hanson Controversy
topics.summary: During the broadcast, discussions shift between an FBI hearing regarding anthrax possession charges and a segment featuring the song ‘Umbop’ by Hanson, including accusations about plastic surgery and concerns over threats in New York City subways. The discussion also includes commentary on neo-Nazis attempting to destabilize America.

topics.title: Anthrax Concerns and Iraqi Diplomacy Discussion
topics.summary: During a radio discussion, hosts explore the potential for anthrax production with varying levels of understanding regarding biological weapons before shifting to President Clinton’s views on diplomacy with Iraq and Kofi Annan’s mission. The conversation includes speculative claims about supermodel origins for the virus and an interrupted call from Saddam Hussein.

topics.title: Olympic Chaos & Shocking News
topics.summary: The broadcast covered a riot at the US hockey team’s Olympic Village hotel after a loss, accusations of room damage, and news about a teacher charged with sexual misconduct. Additionally, it reported on Celestine Tate, a woman born without arms or legs who suffered a critical accident while riding her motorized gurney in Atlantic City.

topics.title: Suhan Murder & Movie Discussions
topics.summary: This broadcast covers the murder of Katrina Suhan, with Tomahl Cook charged in her death following an investigation into a possible accomplice. Simultaneously, discussions centered around Harry Carrey’s recent passing and reviews of new movie releases including ‘Palmetto,’ ‘Dangerous Beauty,’ and ‘Weekend at Bernie’s.’
